summary: Ryde Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of CFO Lang Chen Fei effective July 3, 2026, for personal reasons with no disagreement, and the immediate appointment of Tee Kok Siong @ Tommy Tee as successor. The filing notes Mr. Tee's extensive financial leadership experience, including prior CFO roles, and confirms no family relationships or reportable transactions. This is a routine management transition disclosed via a foreign private issuer report. No other special-situation elements are present. The event is not voluntary but a standard succession, so watch for any future strategic shifts under the new CFO.
